description: This Dart source file defines a mock API service class for a food delivery frontend application, including methods for retrieving restaurants, menus, user login/registration, placing orders, and checking order status. It also contains sample data for restaurants and menu items.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A singleton mock API service class providing asynchronous methods to simulate network calls related to restaurants, menu items, user authentication, and order management.

methods.name: ApiService.factory
methods.description: Factory constructor returning the singleton instance.

methods.name: getRestaurants
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sample restaurants after a delay.

methods.name: getMenuForRestaurant
methods.description: Retrieves sample menu items for a specified restaurant ID after a delay.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates user login returning a sample AppUser object.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Simulates user registration returning a sample AppUser object.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Simulates placing an order, returning a sample Order object with provided details.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a simulated order status for a given order ID.
